scripts.build:rust: cd transit/rust && cargo build --release && cp target/release/libbenchmark_rust.so index.node
scripts.build:c: cd transit/c && npx node-gyp rebuild && cp build/Release/benchmark_c.node index.node
scripts.build:cpp: cd transit/cpp && npx node-gyp rebuild && cp build/Release/benchmark_cpp.node index.node
scripts.install:fastapi: cd fastapi && uv venv && uv pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:grpc: cd grpc && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install setuptools wheel && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m grpc_tools.protoc -I proto --python_out=. --grpc_python_out=. proto/benchmark.proto
scripts.install:thrift: cd thrift && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install setuptools wheel && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/thrift --gen py -out . benchmark.thrift
scripts.install:unix-socket: cd unix-socket && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:subprocess: cd subprocess && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:zeromq: cd zeromq && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:redis-pubsub: cd redis-pubsub && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run build:rust && npm run build:java && npm run install:fastapi && npm run install:grpc && npm run install:thrift && npm run install:unix-socket && npm run install:subprocess && npm run install:zeromq && npm run install:redis-pubsub && npm run build:pyo3
scripts.setup:quick: npm run build:rust && npm run build:java && npm run install:fastapi
